name: Villafranca de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Square crimson flag charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villafranca de la Sierra (an oak on white within a bordure).
history: The arms and the flag were made official on 6 May 1998 (Boletín Oficial del Estado no. 134 of 5 June 1998); the flag is a square flag of proportion 1:1, crimson, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Villafranca de la Sierra arms — oak within a bordure
